claims.title: Bounded-exponent sumsets obstruct one PIT route while nonmonomial features escape a monomial span bound

scoped_dependencies.relation: PIT context only: N682 retains a bounded-sumset obstruction, a nonmonomial quadratic-span example, and failed mechanisms; it provides no hitting set or general PIT algorithm and neither proves nor closes the N250 gate.

interface: Exact report-derived PIT route obstructions and one polynomial-feature representation example; no scalable zero test.
results: Scalarized iterated sumset size <=(ell B+1)^n for A subset {0,...,B}^n.
Source reports a five-feature nonmonomial W with W^2=Q[t]_{<=14}; standalone determinant matrix/archive unavailable.
limits: The ECCC Report 2026/138 Theorem 2 comparison remains an unresolved version-specific correction item; no other result is challenged.
